name: clouddfs-monorepo
description: CloudDFS - A Fault-Tolerant Distributed File Storage System

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:coordinator" "npm run dev:server-1" "npm run dev:server-2" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/storage && npm run build --workspace=packages/database && npm run build --workspace=apps/server
